mid_batch_1.title: Great progress!
mid_batch_1.body: You've completed {completed} of {total} assessments in this batch. Every response counts toward the research, so keep going.

mid_batch_2.title: You're on a roll!
mid_batch_2.body: {completed} of {total} done. Each assessment brings the study closer to an answer.

mid_batch_3.title: Nice momentum!
mid_batch_3.body: {completed} of {total} assessments complete. Your participation is making a real difference.

mid_batch_4.title: Keep it up!
mid_batch_4.body: {completed} of {total} done in this batch. Every answer adds to what the study can learn.

mid_batch_5.title: One step closer!
mid_batch_5.body: {completed} of {total} complete. Thank you for sticking with it. You're nearly there.

almost_there_body: Just one assessment left in this batch. You've got this!

mid_batch_fallback.title: You're doing great!
mid_batch_fallback.body: Every response counts toward the research, so keep going.

batch_complete_body: That's every assessment in this batch. Thank you for participating. Your responses help the research move forward.
standalone_body: Your results will give you valuable insight into your mental health.
standalone_research: Thank you for completing this assessment!
standalone_research_body: Your response helps the research move forward.
share_message: I'm taking part in {title} on Konsulin. Join me:
no_research_subtitle: There are currently no research studies available.
no_studies_subtitle: Register your first study to get started.
consent_description: Your participation in this research study.
consent_intro: Participation is voluntary. Your data is processed in pseudonymized form: you are assigned a random participant ID so you can track your contributions, and researchers cannot access your personal identifying information.
consent_bullet_1: Every questionnaire you complete counts toward the ongoing study.
consent_who: {study} is run by {group} and led by {name}.
consent_batches_repeated: This study has {count} batches. Coming back for each one is welcome, never required.
consent_batches_one_time: This is a one-time study. There is nothing to come back for.
consent_referral: Referral patterns from sharing this study with friends and colleagues are used only to reconstruct the network structure of the research community.
consent_rights: You can review your data, withdraw your consent, or request deletion at any time, in accordance with the GDPR and Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP). Withdrawal does not affect processing carried out before withdrawal.
widget_note: Every questionnaire you complete counts toward the ongoing study
participant_data_note: Individual participant data will be available after anonymization upon study completion.
referral_notice: A friend invited you to this study. Referral patterns are used only to study the structure of the research community.

batch_progress.cached_disclaimer: This is a cached count, updated every 30 minutes to reduce server load.

goal.early_state: You are among the first to join. We show how many people have joined once the group is large enough that no one can be singled out.

overview.get_back_personal: Your own result right after each questionnaire
overview.get_back_comparison: A comparison of your scores across batches
overview.get_back_findings: The study's findings, in everyday language

side_facts.platform: Hosted on Konsulin. Answers travel under a random ID, never your name.

take_part.helper: You will read what taking part means before anything is shared.
take_part.batch_done: Shared for this batch. Thank you.
take_part.after_repeated: The next batch will show up on your home page when it opens.
take_part.after_one_time: This was a one-time study. Findings will appear on your home page.
take_part.researcher_note: This is the page participants see from the study link.

not_found.message: This study is not open. It may have closed, or the link may be incomplete.

studies.title: All studies
studies.count: {shown} of {total} studies. Konsulin studies come first, then the ones closing soonest.
studies.search_placeholder: Search by title, question or group
studies.no_match: No study matches. Try a shorter search or clear a filter.

target_required: Enter a target of at least 1 participant

metadata.question: Research question. One sentence, in everyday words.
metadata.who: Who can join (optional). For example: adults aged 18 and over
metadata.findings: I will share the findings with participants in everyday language

up_next.shared_note: Answer once. It counts toward {count} studies: {titles}.
up_next.reassurance: Stop whenever you like. A screening, not a diagnosis.
up_next.up_to_date: You are up to date. Thank you. Nothing is waiting for you. Studies with more batches will show up here when the next batch opens.
up_next.nothing_joined: You have not joined a study yet. Pick one below. Most take a few minutes, and you see your own result as soon as you finish.

findings.empty: No findings yet. Studies are still collecting answers. When a batch closes, the research team posts what they learned here in everyday language, with the number of people it is based on.

guest_save.body: Your report can be saved for 24 hours. After that, your answers still count toward the study but can no longer be linked to you.

home_intro.title: Take part in research. See what it finds.
home_intro.platform: Every study here runs on Konsulin under the same rules: your answers travel under a random ID, never your name, and you can stop at any time.

researcher_intro.title: Your studies. People give you their answers. This page keeps track of what you owe them back.

trust_strip.heading: True for every study on Konsulin
trust_strip.statement_1: A random ID, not your name. Researchers never see who you are.
trust_strip.statement_2: You stay in control. Review your data, withdraw or delete it at any time.
trust_strip.statement_3: Never sold. Data is collected for research and nothing else.
trust_strip.statement_4: Open platform. The code is public at github.com/konsulin-care
trust_strip.help_link: If things feel heavy right now, find help here

finding_composer.intro: A finding from {title}. Write it the way you would tell a friend. It appears on participants' home pages.
finding_composer.text_label: What did you learn, and how sure are you?
finding_composer.conflict: This study changed while you were writing. Reload and try again.

manage.copy_failed: Could not copy. Copy the link above.

next_step_card.share: Share what you found in batch {index} of {title}. The batch has closed. Participants are waiting to hear what their answers showed.
next_step_card.open: Batch {index} of {title} closes {date}. When it closes, tell participants what you found. Until then, nothing is due from you.
next_step_card.register: Register your first study. Describe it once. The same words become the page people read before taking part.
next_step_card.upcoming: Batch {index} of {title} opens {date}. Nothing is due from you until then.
next_step_card.all_closed: All batches of your studies have closed. Thank you for giving back what you found.
